newsitem.title: UK: Halifax poses threat to UK home insurers.
newsitem.headline: Halifax poses threat to UK home insurers.

text.p: Halifax Building Society is likely to use its size and experience to develop its presence in the household insurance market, management consultancy Datamonitor said in a report on Monday.
"Halifax has a strong brand in relation to house-related financial services. It has the size and capability to swamp the household insurance market and become a financial services 'category killer'".

Datamonitor said home loan specialist Halifax is likely to take more responsibility for the design and development of its general insurance products, which is currently done by Royal & Sun Alliance Plc.
"The implications should send shivers up the spines of the incumbent household insurers," Datamonitor said in its report, 'UK Building Societies: A Bleak Future'.
Halifax, which is in the process of demutualising, will also prove to be a major competitor for UK retail banks and building societies, the report said.
